summary.tldr: Appropriates $75.48 billion for the federal public service for 2022-23.
what_it_does: Authorizes $75,483,404,546 from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for the public service of Canada for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2023.
Covers public service expenses that were not otherwise provided for in that fiscal year.
Became law on Royal Assent, which was March 31, 2022.
summary.background: The bill was introduced in the House of Commons on March 24, 2022. It is an appropriation act for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2023.
